en.headline: Kwong Kau tells High Court he alone dismembered Abby Choi's body
en.dek: The former father-in-law of the slain socialite said he takes full responsibility for disposing of her remains and denied pressuring his elder son to match his evidence.
body: Kwong Kau, the former father-in-law of slain socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung, told the High Court on Wednesday that he alone decided to dismember and dispose of her body after she died in her car on 21 February 2023.

The 68-year-old former police sergeant said neither of his sons, Anthony Kwong Kong-kit or Alex Kwong Kong-chi, had any involvement in the unlawful disposal of the remains. Both sons are also standing trial for murder alongside him.
Kwong denied pressuring his elder son to give evidence that matched his own account. He said he takes full responsibility for the disposal of the body.
The trial continues at the High Court. All three defendants have pleaded not guilty to murder. They previously pleaded guilty to preventing the lawful burial of the corpse.

zh.headline: 鄔球高院稱獨自肢解蔡天鳳遺體並負全責
zh.dek: 蔡天鳳前家翁指事發後決定獨自處理遺體，否認兩名兒子參與，亦否認施壓長子作供配合。
body: 蔡天鳳前家翁鄔球周三在高等法院表示，他在2023年2月21日蔡天鳳於車內死亡後，獨自決定肢解及棄置其遺體。
這名68歲前警司稱，兩名兒子鄔港傑及鄔港智均沒有參與非法棄置遺體。三父子同被控謀殺，案件正在高等法院審理。
鄔球否認曾施壓長子作供以配合他的說法，並表示自己對棄置遺體一事負上全責。
案件繼續審理。三名被告均不承認謀殺罪，他們早前已承認妨礙合法埋葬屍體罪。
